ASCII Art Text Generator

Turn any text into big ASCII art letters with 3 hand-built 5-row fonts: block, banner and small.


    

  

  





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Type text (A–Z, 0–9 work best).
  2. Pick Block, Banner or Small font.
  3. Press Generate.
  4. Copy the ASCII art.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Which fonts are included?
Block (bold filled), Banner (wide display) and Small (compact 3-wide) — all hand-drawn for A–Z and 0–9.
What about lowercase or symbols?
Unknown characters render as blank space and line breaks are preserved.
Where can I use the output?
Results are plain text — paste them into code comments, terminals, READMEs or social bios.
